items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: I got my horn back from Johnny...and I start... I believe I started giving him sessions at my house

ctx.x: Is Johnny in the Union now? I don't know.
I haven't seen Johnny in, oh God knows when, Dick.

I saw him a few months ago. He was at Tulane. I didn't know what the hell he was. He's a fine boy. He is. Uh, when you started out on trumpet, did you sit in any before you ever began to come professional?
